open_questions.title: A great moment
open_questions.text: Tell us about a great moment from a recent day out. Where were you, what was happening, how did it feel?
open_questions.follow_up: Is there anything else you'd like to add about that?
examples: Sitting on the top deck of a bus over Waterloo Bridge at dusk. Tired, but happy.
Eating street food by the river with friends. No plan, lots of laughing.
Swimming in a cold lake, then a hot drink. I felt completely awake.

why_travel.prompt: How do you most want to feel on a day out? Pick up to two, or none.

swipe.prompt: Have you been? How did it feel?

conjoint.prompt: Which day sounds more like you? There's no right answer.

photos.text: How much do photos and sharing matter on your trips?

example_shot_card.title: Waterloo Bridge at sunset, both ways

approach.path: Walk to the south end of the bridge by the Southbank Centre and up to the middle

example_shot_card.what_happens: From the middle of the bridge you look west to Parliament and the London Eye, then cross the road and look east to St Paul's and the City's towers catching the last light.

best_time.light: Sunset; late autumn and winter skies are the best (CHECKED)

stand_at.note: The middle of the bridge, at the railing; then cross the road to the other side

shot_card.face: West (upriver) first; then cross over and face east (downriver)
shot_card.frame: West: the river leading to Parliament, with the London Eye in the shot. East: St Paul's dome with the City's towers behind it
shot_card.when: The 20 minutes either side of sunset: around 4:30pm after the clocks go back on 25 Oct, around 6pm in mid-October
shot_card.avoid: Stepping into the road for the shot; stay on the pavement
